elements_selected.content:
Create themes/minimal/ — a stripped-down theme that demonstrates theme authoring with the smallest possible surface. This theme overrides base.html to remove the DaisyUI/Tailwind CDN dependencies and uses inline CSS for a clean, typography-focused look. page.html, index.html, and folder.html extend the minimal base.html.

Design constraints:
  - No CDN dependencies — fully self-contained HTML/CSS
  - System font stack only (no web fonts)
  - Light background, dark text, minimal colour palette
  - Sidebar navigation still functional
  - Search modal still works (reuse the JS from default or simplify)
  - Responsive: readable on mobile without the drawer component

Add theme.toml:
```toml
[theme]
name = "minimal"
version = "0.9.0"
description = "A minimal, typography-focused theme with no CDN dependencies"
author = "zetl contributors"
license = "AGPL-3.0"

[theme.templates]
overrides = ["base.html", "index.html", "page.html", "folder.html"]
```
